profile_text.body:
Brightwheel describes itself on its website as an all-in-one childcare management platform, used for billing, communication, attendance, and more. The company says it is the most trusted platform of its kind, and it markets the product to early childhood programs around the start of the school year. Its site also notes that by submitting a contact form, users agree brightwheel may reach them by phone call, SMS, or email, including through automated technology, prerecorded messages, or AI-assisted systems, for marketing and informational purposes.

The company is tracked as an Education and Research AI product, found in research for The AI Ready School and not independently verified. Its stated use is child care management and family communication, for early childhood programs, families, and staff, with no child accounts. AI features are not verified, privacy terms are not verified, and pricing is custom by quote, though some states provide it free to providers according to a user review.
